info.description: Protected Control Plane APIs for Layr Platform
info.title: Layr Control Plane API Engine

get.description: Retrieves dynamic runtime authentication configuration with secrets projected as boolean indicators.

put.description: Updates dynamic runtime auth configuration, envelope-encrypting new secrets with master encryption key.
put.summary: Update dynamic runtime auth configuration with write-only secrets

get.description: Lists registered application users with pagination, role filters, and search capabilities.
get.summary: List registered application users with filtering and pagination

post.description: Creates a new application user account directly through the control plane.
post.summary: Create a new application user account

delete.description: Permanently deletes user account and cascades deletion to sessions and identities.
delete.summary: Delete application user and cascade related sessions/identities

get.description: Retrieves full user account details including identities, verification status, and lockout metadata.
get.summary: Get detailed user record by UUID

delete.description: Unlocks user account and restores login capabilities.
delete.summary: Unlock application user and restore access

post.description: Locks user account to prevent authentication and revokes all active sessions immediately.
post.summary: Lock application user and revoke active sessions

get.description: Lists all active sessions for a specific user, including IP address, user agent, and expiration time.
get.summary: List active sessions for an application user

post.description: Revokes all active sessions and refresh tokens for the specified user.
post.summary: Revoke all active sessions for an application user

get.description: Returns active dynamic console configuration settings.
Returns all registered console operator users.

post.description: Creates a new console operator with credentials.

delete.description: Deletes a console operator and cascades session revocation.

get.description: Returns a single console operator user by ID.

put.description: Modifies email or active status of a console user.

post.description: Rotates user password and revokes all active operator sessions.

get.description: Returns active sessions for a console user.

post.description: Terminates all active sessions for a console operator.

get.description: Lists all active event hooks with driver, target URLs/functions, events, and retry policies.

post.description: Creates an event hook subscription for SQL stored procedure or HTTP webhook dispatching.

get.description: Retrieves an event hook by UUID.

put.description: Updates event hook driver, targets, subscribed events, secret, or enabled status.

get.description: Queries recent dispatch attempts, response status, and latency for an event hook.

post.description: Manually redrives a past event hook delivery attempt.

get.description: Queries immutable system and domain events with multi-field filtering and pagination.
Retrieves an individual event entry by UUID.
Lists all machine service accounts with status, name, and permission scopes.

post.description: Creates a machine service account, generates a 32-byte hex secret key, and hashes it.
post.summary: Create a new machine service account

delete.description: Deletes a machine service account, enforcing invariant that at least one root account remains.

get.description: Retrieves a service account by UUID.

put.description: Updates service account scopes, name, or enabled status while protecting root accounts.

post.description: Flushes in-memory and distributed query result caches across all cluster nodes.
post.summary: Flush all global query and schema reflection caches

post.description: Invalidates reflection and query caches for a specific table or schema pattern.
post.summary: Programmatically invalidate specific table or catalog caches

get.description: Retrieves dynamic runtime data service settings including exposed schemas, pool sizes, and cache TTL rules.

put.description: Updates dynamic runtime data service configuration without requiring server restarts.

get.description: Queries PostgreSQL information_schema and pg_catalog to list tables, primary keys, and approximate row counts.
get.summary: List all user tables across configured schemas

post.description: Executes DDL to create a table adhering to Layr invariants (UUIDv7 primary keys and timestamps).
post.summary: Create a new PostgreSQL table with UUIDv7 primary key

delete.description: Drops a table and its associated constraints, indexes, and triggers from PostgreSQL.

get.description: Retrieves column definitions, foreign keys, indexes, and RLS policies for a specific table.
get.summary: Inspect table schema, columns, indexes, and constraints

post.description: Alters table schema to add a new column with type validation and optional default values.
post.summary: Add a new column to a table

delete.description: Drops a column from a table schema.
delete.summary: Drop a column from a table

patch.description: Alters column attributes or renames a column.
patch.summary: Alter column type, default, nullable, or rename

get.description: Lists all indexes defined on the specified table.

post.description: Creates a B-Tree, GIN, GiST, or BRIN index on table columns.
post.summary: Create an index on a table

delete.summary: Drop an index from a table

get.description: Lists Row-Level Security policies with USING and WITH CHECK SQL expressions.
get.summary: List RLS policies on a table

post.description: Creates an RLS policy defining declarative access rules for roles and commands.
post.summary: Create a Row-Level Security policy on a table

delete.description: Drops an RLS policy from a table.
delete.summary: Drop an RLS policy from a table

patch.description: Toggles Row-Level Security enforcement mode on a table.

get.description: Returns all configured storage buckets and their backend configurations.

post.description: Creates a new bucket with either database or S3 backend.

delete.description: Deletes a bucket and cascades deletion to all contained objects.

get.description: Returns configuration and status for a specific bucket.

patch.description: Updates bucket properties such as public flag, backend config, or size limits.

get.description: Returns metadata of objects stored within a specific bucket.
Returns dynamic runtime settings for the file storage subsystem.

put.description: Updates dynamic runtime settings for the file storage subsystem.

get.description: Returns the dynamic operational configuration for the function runtime subsystem.

put.description: Modifies dynamic operational configuration settings for the function runtime subsystem.

get.description: Returns all registered custom domains.

post.description: Registers a standalone custom domain hostname.

delete.description: Removes a registered custom domain and cascades its routes.

get.description: Returns all registered serverless endpoints.

post.description: Registers a new serverless endpoint definition.

delete.description: Permanently removes an endpoint definition and unloads it from running runtimes.

get.description: Returns details of a single serverless endpoint definition.

put.description: Modifies an existing serverless endpoint definition.

post.description: Uploads an immutable code bundle and hot-reloads it in the active runtime runner.

get.description: Returns immutable deployment version history for an endpoint.
Returns all custom domain routes attached to an endpoint.

post.description: Attaches an endpoint to a custom domain route with a path prefix.

delete.description: Removes an endpoint route mapping from a custom domain.

get.description: Returns historical invocation logs for a specific endpoint including status codes, duration, stdout, and stderr.

post.description: Restores an earlier immutable deployment version as active.

get.description: Returns historical invocation logs including status codes, duration, stdout, and stderr.
Returns telemetry, active isolates count, memory usage, and runner statuses.
Returns the dynamic operational configuration settings for the image service.

put.description: Modifies dynamic operational configuration settings such as quality, resolution limits, and domain allowlists.

get.description: Returns all configured transformation presets.

post.description: Creates a new named transformation preset with processing option definitions.

delete.description: Deletes a transformation preset by ID.

get.description: Returns a single transformation preset definition.

put.description: Modifies an existing transformation preset definition.

get.description: Returns real-time cache hit ratios, throughput metrics, and memory utilization statistics.

post.description: Generates a cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 URL for an image transformation path.

get.description: Returns dynamic concurrency limits, timeout guards, and backoff settings.

put.description: Updates dynamic operational parameters including concurrency and retry backoff limits.

get.description: Inspects dead-lettered executions that exhausted all retry attempts.

delete.description: Permanently removes a failed execution from the dead-letter queue.

post.description: Resets a dead-lettered execution to pending for immediate re-attempt.
post.summary: Re-queue a failed task from DLQ

get.description: Returns historical execution status logs, durations, and errors.

post.description: Manually enqueues an execution for immediate processing out-of-schedule.

get.description: Returns all registered recurring cron jobs with next run countdowns.

post.description: Creates a new recurring cron job schedule definition with target parameters.
post.summary: Register a new recurring cron job

delete.description: Deletes a job definition and cancels associated pending queued executions.

get.description: Returns a single cron job definition with next execution countdown.
get.summary: Get cron job details by ID

patch.description: Modifies schedule expressions, timezone, payloads, or active status.

get.description: Returns real-time job counts, queue depths, DLQ sizes, and success rates.
